title: Shark Plank
description: A hangman game for kids who are just learning to read. Pick a letter, hear the word read aloud, and keep your explorer off the plank. Guess wrong too many times and the shark jumps out of the water! Earn stars for every word you solve.

pt.description: Um jogo da forca para crianças que estão aprendendo a ler, com palavras em inglês. Escolha uma letra, ouça a palavra em voz alta e não deixe seu explorador cair da prancha. Se errar muitas vezes, o tubarão pula da água! Ganhe estrelas por cada palavra que você descobrir.

fr.description: Un jeu du pendu pour les enfants qui apprennent à lire, avec des mots anglais. Choisis une lettre, écoute le mot lu à voix haute et garde ton explorateur sur la planche. Si tu te trompes trop souvent, le requin saute hors de l’eau ! Gagne des étoiles pour chaque mot trouvé.

es.description: Un juego del ahorcado para niños que están aprendiendo a leer, con palabras en inglés. Elige una letra, escucha la palabra en voz alta y no dejes que tu explorador se caiga de la tabla. Si fallas demasiadas veces, ¡el tiburón salta del agua! Gana estrellas por cada palabra que resuelvas.

de.description: Ein Galgenmännchen-Spiel mit englischen Wörtern für Kinder, die gerade lesen lernen. Wähle einen Buchstaben, hör dir das Wort vorlesen und halte deinen Entdecker auf der Planke. Rätst du zu oft falsch, springt der Hai aus dem Wasser! Für jedes gelöste Wort gibt es Sterne.

he.description: משחק איש תלוי עם מילים באנגלית לילדים שרק לומדים לקרוא. בחרו אות, הקשיבו למילה בקול ושמרו על החוקר שלכם על הקרש. טועים יותר מדי פעמים? הכריש קופץ מהמים! הרוויחו כוכבים על כל מילה שפתרתם.

ja.description: 字をよみはじめた子どものための、えいごのことばでやる ハングマンゲームです。もじをえらんで、ことばを声できいて、たんけんかが いたからおちないようにしよう。まちがえすぎると、サメが水から とびだすよ！ ことばをとくたびに ほしがもらえます。
ja.tags: ハングマン,スペル,よむ,えいご,ことば,サメ,もじ

ar.description: لعبة الرجل المشنوق بكلمات إنجليزية للأطفال الذين يتعلّمون القراءة. اختر حرفًا، واستمع إلى الكلمة بصوت عالٍ، وأبقِ المستكشف على اللوح. إذا أخطأت مرات كثيرة، يقفز القرش من الماء! اربح نجومًا عن كل كلمة تحلّها.

ru.description: Игра «Виселица» с английскими словами для детей, которые только учатся читать. Выбери букву, послушай, как звучит слово, и не дай исследователю упасть с доски. Ошибёшься слишком много раз — из воды выпрыгнет акула! За каждое отгаданное слово ты получаешь звёзды.

it.description: Un gioco dell’impiccato con parole inglesi per bambini che stanno imparando a leggere. Scegli una lettera, ascolta la parola letta ad alta voce e tieni il tuo esploratore sull’asse. Se sbagli troppe volte, lo squalo salta fuori dall’acqua! Guadagna stelle per ogni parola che indovini.

zh-Hant.description: 給剛開始學認字的小朋友玩的英文猜字遊戲（吊死鬼）。選一個字母，聽聽單字怎麼唸，別讓探險家掉下木板。猜錯太多次，鯊魚就會跳出水面！每猜中一個單字就能得到星星。
zh-Hant.tags: 猜字,拼字,閱讀,英文,初學,鯊魚,字母

nl.description: Galgje met Engelse woorden voor kinderen die net leren lezen. Kies een letter, luister hoe het woord klinkt en houd je ontdekkingsreiziger op de plank. Raad je te vaak fout, dan springt de haai uit het water! Verdien sterren voor elk woord dat je raadt.

notes: Built on the Oomba Kit 1.1.0 (pinned kit tag plus the art-animals, art-school, art-props and dress packs): the kit's beach world behind the game (night in the dark theme), the kit's title screen, HUD (six hearts for the plank steps left, a star counter for words won), pause (Esc; P is a letter), settings, sounds, icons, buttons and font. The explorer on the plank is the player's own character (Oomba.avatar()); guests get a kid explorer (Oomba.char, species kid) instead of the mascot. It is drawn from the kit's portrait art in a mood that follows the danger (cheerful, then thinking, then surprised). The sea scene (ship, plank, shark, chomp, burp and spit-back, splashes, confetti) is a Canvas 2D drawing in the Oomba Ink style (kit colours, Ink outlines, sized with Oomba.fit). Picture clues use the kit's art when it has the thing (cat, dog, bus, apple, rocket...) and the emoji otherwise. The game's name stays on screen while playing; the word, keys and tools sit on one calm panel; phones keep a sound button on the HUD. A win keeps a big YOU DID IT! banner across the sea (the card has no second heading); a loss keeps the shark up with a BURP! over it. After each word a results card shows the word as letter tiles (letters the player missed in red) with its picture (sparks for few misses on a win) and the next step. Uses localStorage key 'shark-plank-stars' for the star total and speechSynthesis for read-aloud (fine inside the sandbox). Loads the Google Font Andika for the letters (keys and word slots: the a and g children learn to write). UI is translated into all 13 site languages from BRB.user.lang (I18N table); the hidden words stay English and are read aloud with an en-US voice. window.__brbTest exposes state/start for verifiers.
